items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: George Butler was very easy to work with, very helpful, very well dressed, very well mannered.

ctx.x: But with George, when George came on board, George Butler came on board . . .
He was the guy. He was the head of the jazz department. Very – George Butler was very easy to work with, very helpful, very well dressed, very well mannered. George was a nice guy.
I know his sister, Jackie Hairston, in Oakland.
